def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    priorities[valid_mask] = -np.log(bins[valid_mask] - item + 1)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    fill_ratio = item / bins[valid_mask]
    priorities[valid_mask] = -np.abs(fill_ratio - 0.5)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    remaining_capacity = bins[valid_mask] - item
    # Avoid division by zero by ensuring remaining capacity is not zero
    safe_remaining = np.where(remaining_capacity == 0, 1e-10, remaining_capacity)
    priorities[valid_mask] = - (item / safe_remaining)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    remaining = bins[valid_mask] - item
    # Prioritize bins where the item takes up a large fraction of the remaining capacity
    # This encourages filling bins more efficiently and reduces small leftover spaces
    efficiency = item / (bins[valid_mask] + 1e-8)  # Avoid division by zero
    priorities[valid_mask] = efficiency * remaining
    return priorities

    remaining = bins - np.fmin(bins, item)
    # Prioritize bins with more remaining capacity (higher values are better)

    epsilon = 1e-8
    priorities = remaining + epsilon
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    return np.where(rem >= 0, -rem, -np.inf)
